# What fuse-figma's `test:compare` self-check reads, as git pathspecs, one per line. The merge
# workflow's figma-compare job renders only when one of these changed since its base
# (.github/scripts/figma-compare-affected.sh). test/merge-task-graph.test.mjs checks that every
# package the task's turbo graph builds is listed. A path listed too broadly costs a render; one
# left out lets a change skip the check.

# fuse-figma's sources and scripts
packages/fuse-figma
:(exclude)packages/fuse-figma/README.md
:(exclude)packages/fuse-figma/test
:(exclude)packages/fuse-figma/plugin
:(exclude,glob)packages/fuse-figma/**/*.test.ts

# The Fuse build the cells render, its build scripts, and the sources the kit reads directly
packages/fuse/src
:(exclude,glob)packages/fuse/src/**/*.test.*
:(exclude,glob)packages/fuse/src/**/__snapshots__/**
packages/fuse/scripts
packages/fuse/package.json
packages/fuse/tsconfig.json
packages/fuse/tsdown.config.ts

# The color package, which Fuse's theme and the kit import from source
packages/color/src
:(exclude,glob)packages/color/src/**/*.test.*
packages/color/package.json

# The TypeScript config the builds extend
tooling/typescript

# Dependencies and the task graph
package.json
pnpm-lock.yaml
pnpm-workspace.yaml
patches
turbo.json

# The job and its setup
.github/workflows/merge.yml
.github/actions/setup-playwright
.github/scripts/install-playwright-deps.sh
.github/scripts/figma-compare-affected.sh
.github/figma-compare-inputs.txt
